nodes.name: Alchemy Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Alchemy Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling potion brewing and medicine crafting.

nodes.name: Cooking Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Cooking Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling recipe discovery, food preparation, and cooking.

nodes.name: Blacksmithing Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Blacksmithing Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling ore smelting and weapon forging.

nodes.name: Armorsmithing Bench
nodes.description: Unlocks the Armorsmithing Bench for the Guild Outpost, enabling hide tailoring and silk weaving into armor.

nodes.name: Digging
nodes.description: Unlocks excavation and dig spots in dungeons, uncovering buried resources, soil, and curiosities.

nodes.name: Harvest Enemy Skin
nodes.description: Unlocks Skinning, allowing pelts, hides, and silk to be harvested from animal corpses in dungeons.

nodes.name: Harvest Enemy Meat
nodes.description: Unlocks Butchering, allowing raw meat to be carved from eligible non-undead corpses in dungeons.

nodes.name: Bowyer Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Bowyer Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling the crafting and shaping of wooden bows and strings.

nodes.name: Gardening
nodes.description: Unlocks planting plots for cultivating crops in the Outpost and begins the study of agriculture.
